### Price Mismatches
Your product data price doesn't match the price on your website page. The affected products are:
* **Waffle Weave Bath Towel, Sage** (ID: `HG-004`): Feed price is 32.00 USD, but the product page shows 36.00 USD.
* **Pour Over Coffee Set, Glass and Copper** (ID: `HG-015`): Feed price is 58.00 USD, but the product page shows 64.00 USD.
* **Stainless Steel Kettle, 1.7 L** (ID: `HG-021`): Feed price is 48.00 USD, but the product page shows 44.00 USD.

**How to fix:**
Update the price in your product data so it matches your website exactly, then re-upload your data. Google will recheck these products within a few hours or days. For details, see [Price in the feed does not match the website](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/12159029).

To help prevent future price mismatches, you can turn on automatic price updates under **Products** > **Automations tab**. For more information, see [Automatic item updates for price and availability](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/3246284).
